title: 🍿 Princess Mononoke Cozy Afternoon Watch Party
description:
Get out of the house and watch Princess Mononoke with us! You're welcome to simple watch the movie or bring a quiet activity to enjoy while we watch together—knitting, crocheting, journaling, coloring, or any other low-key project.

This isn't a movie theater. It's a cozy afternoon in with good company.
Your ticket includes:
✨ Admission to the watch party
🍿 Light snacks and little bites
🍵 Tea and refreshments
🌿 A relaxed, welcoming atmosphere
Bring your favorite blanket or cozy sweater if you'd like, and settle in for a chill afternoon of beautiful animation, creativity, and community.
